title: Whole-breast radiotherapy after lumpectomy for DCIS
population: 818 women with localized DCIS and histologically tumor-free margins
summary: Adding 50 Gy whole-breast radiotherapy after lumpectomy reduced 8-year invasive ipsilateral breast recurrence from 13.4% to 3.9%, an absolute reduction of 9.5 percentage points. Five-year event-free survival was 84.4% versus 73.8%.
criticalReview: B-17 established the local-control benefit of radiotherapy after lumpectomy for DCIS. The absolute benefit is substantial for recurrence but did not translate into a demonstrable overall-survival advantage because breast-cancer deaths were uncommon. NNT is approximately 11 based on 5-year event-free survival; a single trial-specific NNH is not reliably quantifiable.
